title: SS28 Boys' Season Colour Analysis
summary: SS28 boyswear colour is projected around turquoise and deep sky with acid lemon, on inky blue and linen.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Forecut's SS28 colour forecast: royal blue and a new turquoise beside greyish mauve and violet, over straw and bleached linen, with an after-dark edge<sup>[1]</sup>
- Copenhagen SS27 data showed colour returning and neutrals fading; Jacquemus built its SS27 show around turquoise and orange<sup>[2]</sup>
- Its named colours include Aubergine Skin, Solar Midnight, Smoky Lavender and Swamp Green, with Cloud Bloom as a luminous counterpoint and Fruit Punch for "juicy intensity"; dark shades work best with contrast, not head to toe<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** bleached linen, inky blue.
- **Seasonal:** sonar turquoise, deep sky, greyish mauve.
- **Accent:** acid lemon, peach.

sections.heading: By product
sections.body:
- Turquoise and sky: swim and play.
- Lemon: tees and accessories.
- Peach and mauve: dresses and baby.

design_implications:
- Lab-dip key colours on each main fabric before committing.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Keep the core deep and the accents shallow until the fairs confirm them.
